  FROM enrollments

),

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY cnt DESC, course_id) AS rn

)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lesson_count FROM lessons l JOIN chapters ch ON l.chapter_id = ch.id JOIN courses c ON ch.course_id = c.id WHERE c.category = 'devops';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cert_count FROM certificates c JOIN courses co ON co.id = c.course_id WHERE co.category = 'devops';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN qa.score >= q.passing_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pass_rate_pct
FROM quiz_attempts qa
JOIN quizzes q ON q.id = qa.quiz_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = q.course_id
WHERE c.category = 'devops' AND qa.score IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS n FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE c.category = 'devops' AND LOWER(e.status) IN ('active','completed') AND u.is_deleted = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%course%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE body LIKE '%extension%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM courses WHERE title LIKE 'Intro to%'
SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%instructions%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%instructions%' AND hidden = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lesson_count FROM lessons WHERE title LIKE 'Lesson 3%';
SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS net_revenue FROM orders WHERE LOWER(status) = 'paid' GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY paid_orders DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, capacity - booked AS seats_left FROM live_classes WHERE capacity - booked > 0 ORDER BY seats_left DESC

SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(s.id) AS session_count, SUM(s.seconds) / 3600.0 AS total_hours FROM users u JOIN study_sessions s ON s.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING COUNT(s.id) > 10 ORDER BY total_hours DESC
SELECT enrollment_id, AVG(completed) AS completed_share FROM progress GROUP BY enrollment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY completed_share DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT c.id, c.title, COUNT(l.id) AS lesson_count, ROUND(SUM(l.duration_min) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours FROM courses c JOIN chapters ch ON ch.course_id = c.id JOIN lessons l ON l.chapter_id = ch.id GROUP BY c.id, c.title HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_hours DESC
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM orders;

SELECT course_id,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS cancel_ratio
FROM enrollments
GROUP BY course_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY course_id;
